thread:
maria: NorthStar reported an oddity: Feb consolidated settlement includes the same usage twice across two settlement windows. They say AWS applied a late metering file after cutoff. Can someone triage? :thinking_face:
ashok: Can you paste the two settlement rows they attached and our invoice lines?
maria: Partner attached two rows from AWS settlement: 
```
settlement_window,sku,units,unit_settled
2026-02-01_to_2026-02-28,redwood_stream_e1,5000,0.0020
2026-02-28_to_2026-03-31,redwood_stream_e1,5000,0.0020
```
Our invoice to customer shows single usage for Feb: 
```
INV-2026-02-4890
SKU: redwood_stream_e1
Qty: 5000
Unit price: $0.0020
Line net: $10.00
```
maria: So partner got credited/paid for the same 5k units twice (two settlement windows). They want us to handle the duplicate.
aws-partner-bot: AWS support ticket AWS-17992: AWS confirms late metering file accepted after Feb cutoff and included in Mar settlement. They said they cannot automatically retract processed settlements; recommend buyer/reseller dispute with us for adjustments.
james: billing-bot, which exporter run created the metering file for the late rows? Any indication of duplicate submission?
billing-bot: metering export logs: usage batch 2026-02-28T23:59:58Z produced usage_id U-zz-5000; duplicate batch submitted 2026-03-02T01:12:10Z produced usage_id U-zz-5000-dup with same canonical_id. Exporter version at time: metering-worker@v1.9.2. No de-duplication flag was set for late ingestion.
ashok: That looks like our retry path re-submitted the same events when the upstream ack timed out. The retried payload got a new usage_id and AWS accepted it in the next window. Engineering needs to prevent resending canonical usage_id values.
sophie: I filed ENG-PR-2983 to add idempotency check in metering-worker and to mark delivered IDs to avoid re-send. James, can you own the hotfix?
james: I will. Plan: add idempotency table + improve ack handling, cut hotfix v1.9.3. ETA 6 hours. Also will add a backfill job to identify duplicates by canonical_id over the past 60 days.
maria: Finance: partner asks for $10 credit (5000 * 0.0020) to reverse duplicate payout. Can AP approve provisional credit memo while we complete audit?
kelly: AP here. For duplicate settlement credits under $250 we can approve provisional credits pending engineering audit and AWS confirmation. Need: invoice id (provided), reconciliation export link, and AWS ticket.
maria: Reconciliation file uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/aws/recons/2026-02/northstar-dup-1799958765.csv. Internal export link: https://internal.redwood/billing/exports/1799958765 (md5:3a7bd3e2360a3d3c). AWS ticket AWS-17992 attached.
kelly: OK approve provisional CM-2026-02-012 for $10 to NorthStar. Will post in 2 business days and mark provisional pending final reconciliation.
ashok: Also recommend we scan other merchants for duplicate canonical_id submissions between Feb 20 and Mar 5 and flag any > $100 cumulative. James can you post scan results here after hotfix?
james: Will run scan after finishing hotfix and post findings. Preliminary quick check shows ~2 other small duplicates totalling ~$7. I'll include in report.
sophie: I'll tell NorthStar we issued a provisional credit and are working on a technical fix. I'll also ask AWS if they can void the late metering row as a courtesy.
maria: Thanks. Leaving thread open until CM posts and PR merges. :thumbsup:
